builds.title: Avariel ridge sentry, Fighter 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 4 (1 class HD, LA +3).
traits: Neutral good. Studded leather +3, Dexterity +4. Touch 14, flat-footed 13, armor check penalty −1. BAB +1, grapple +3. Fortitude +3, Reflex +4, Will +1.

Immune to magical sleep. +2 racial bonus on saves against enchantment spells and effects. Low-light vision. +2 racial Listen and Search. Passing within 5 ft. of a secret or concealed door grants a Search check as if actively looking.

Fly 50 ft. (average) when carrying a Medium load or less, wearing no heavy armor, and neither fatigued nor exhausted. The wings must have room to extend fully. A Run in flight must follow a straight line.
Average maneuverability requires at least 25 ft. of forward movement each round to stay aloft and provides no hover. Upward flight is at half speed, with a maximum ascent angle of 60 degrees.
Weapon Finesse applies Dexterity to the rapier attack roll. Flyby Attack lets Sael take one standard action during a flying move.
actions: On a clear dive-charge line that descends at least 30 ft., rapier +7 melee, 2d6+4 piercing on a hit or 3d6+6 on a confirmed critical. AC 15 until Sael’s next turn.
Flyby Attack. Split one flying move around a standard rapier attack at +5. Use the ordinary attack damage.
builds.tactics: Sael patrols the exposed ridge. He makes a flyby pass when he has room to keep moving. He saves the dive for an open line with enough height.

builds.title: Avariel pass medic, Cleric 2
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 5 (2 class HD, LA +3).
traits: Chaotic good. Chain shirt +4, light wooden shield +1, Dexterity +3. Touch 13, flat-footed 15, armor check penalty −3. BAB +1, grapple +2. Fortitude +4, Reflex +3, Will +6.

Immune to magical sleep. +2 racial bonus on saves against enchantment spells and effects. Low-light vision. +2 racial Listen and Search. Passing within 5 ft. of a secret or concealed door grants a Search check as if actively looking.

Fly 50 ft. (average) when carrying a Medium load or less, wearing no heavy armor, and neither fatigued nor exhausted. The wings must have room to extend fully. A Run in flight must follow a straight line.
Average maneuverability requires at least 25 ft. of forward movement each round to stay aloft and provides no hover. Upward flight is at half speed, with a maximum ascent angle of 60 degrees.

Cleric of Shaundakul. Travel grants freedom of movement against magical impediments for up to 2 rounds/day. Air grants 4 shared uses/day to turn or destroy earth creatures or rebuke or command air creatures.
Combat Casting gives +4 to Concentration when casting defensively or while grappled or pinned.
actions: Cleric caster level 2. Prepared orisons, 4 slots, DC 13. Detect magic, guidance, light, and cure minor wounds (heals 1 HP).

Prepared 1st level, 3 slots plus 1 domain slot, DC 14 when relevant. Bless (+1 morale on attacks and saves against fear for 2 minutes), cure light wounds (1d8+2 healing), shield of faith (+2 deflection AC for 2 minutes), and domain longstrider (+10 ft. to own land speed for 2 hours). Can swap prepared non-domain spells for cure spells.
Turn undead 4/day, Charisma check 1d20+1, turning damage 2d6+3. Air domain uses its own pool and the same check and damage.
builds.tactics: Iri starts with bless when there is time. She flies to a clear landing near the injured and treats them on the ground.

concepts.name: Sael Frostpinion
concepts.motive: Warn the lower outpost before a rockslide cuts off the pass.
concepts.hook: Sael asks the party to watch the narrow trail while he checks the ridge from above.

concepts.name: Iri Windward
concepts.role: Pass medic and Cleric of Shaundakul.
concepts.hook: Iri can see a place to land beside the porters if someone opens the shuttered terrace.
